business_problem: turn unstructured financial-data emails and reference content into usable structured workflows while reducing the cost and operational burden of enterprise gen AI adoption.
solution_summary: TS Imagine uses Snowflake, Cortex AI, Streamlit in Snowflake, and Secure Data Sharing on Snowflake to turn unstructured financial-data emails and reference content into usable structured workflows while reducing the cost and operational burden of enterprise gen ai adoption. Market data, client-facing financial content, and unstructured operational emails are consolidated in Snowflake so TS Imagine can apply gen AI without moving sensitive data outside the platform. Cortex AI powers the RAG-based email workflow and other gen AI use cases, while Streamlit in Snowflake makes conversational access and internal AI applications easier to operationalize quickly. Operations and data teams use the outputs to categorize emails, create JIRA tasks, answer business questions through chatbot experiences, and share governed data products with clients more easily.
